Taxes and fees at Sao Paulo hotels

At the 13 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 5% ($5 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 4% at DELPLAZA Excelsior São Paulo - By Monreale to 5% at Hostel More SP. At 4 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
